title: Scrapbook: Jeff Kelly's band and old arrangements
summary: Looking at a c. 1930 photo of Jeff Kelly's band, Thomas names the members and their hometowns, then shows orchestrations from show leaders.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
